Protocol.description: Protocol family and major version, e.g. wakecore.ui-runtime/1

cancel_requested.description: false when the act had already ended

model_egress.description: the model egress the caller's approval covers; if present and different from the runtime's (see health), the act is refused with 409 model_egress_mismatch before anything is sent. Not part of the request digest.

mutating_requests.description: writes that may have reached the site (journalled before release)

status_response.description: GET /v1/act/status?key= (legacy, kept): never_received | in_progress | finished | interrupted

act.v1.description: Guarded Computer Use on one page (the hand). At most once per `key`: a repeat returns the journalled result (`deduplicated: true`); the same key with a different request (session_ref, goal, start_url, origins, login) is 409 idempotency_key_reused. A previous attempt that provably sent nothing may be superseded by a request with a new `attempt`. `completed` is only the model's claim: clients MUST verify with a fresh observation.
act.v1.title: POST /v1/act

act_record.v1.description: The journal record of one act key: what was sent (method + path, never bodies or query strings), what was blocked, the result and the evidence files.

ref.description: relative to the runtime's state directory

act_record.v1.title: GET /v1/acts/{key}

capabilities.v1.description: What this runtime implements, so a client can check a task before it is scheduled.

history.description: how turns are chained: previous_response_id (server) or the full conversation resent by the runtime (client)

variant.description: function = the actions as a plain function tool, for endpoints without the hosted computer tool

capabilities.v1.title: GET /v1/capabilities

act_key.description: The kernel's effect_key. An act is performed at most once per key.

origins.description: scheme://host[:port]. Every request the browser makes (including subresources) must be inside this list.

protocol.description: Protocol identifier; the major version is the number after the slash.

url.description: scheme://host/path only: no query string, no body.

session_ref.description: Opaque name of a browser profile a human logged into. Never a cookie or a credential.

common.v1.title: UI Runtime protocol v1: shared definitions

error.v1.description: Every non-2xx response. `retryable` says whether the same request may succeed later unchanged. Never echoes request bodies, cookies or keys.
error.v1.title: UI Runtime protocol v1: error envelope

attr.description: list mode: read this attribute instead of innerText

default.description: used only when declared: the cell is missing, the pattern does not match or the value does not parse

pattern.description: Python regex, searched in the text; the value is `group` (default 0)

selector.description: list mode: relative to the item; "" = the item itself

extractor.v1.description: Exactly one of `table` / `list`, and exactly one of `key_attr` / `key_field`. The runtime's validator is authoritative and additionally checks cross-field rules (key_field names a column, patterns compile, `group` exists, defaults match the type). See docs/extractor.md.
extractor.v1.title: Declarative extractor v1 (DOM -> records, deterministic, no model)

health.v1.description: Cheap liveness + protocol negotiation. Clients MUST refuse a runtime whose `protocol` major version they do not speak.

model_egress.description: the data-egress target a grant and an approval must name for acts on this runtime, e.g. model:openai-computer-use or model:openai-compatible:<host>

model_endpoint.description: host the screenshots are sent to (OpenAI or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint)

health.v1.title: GET /v1/health

extractor.description: extractor.v1.schema.json; an invalid one is outcome SCHEMA_INVALID

observe.v1.description: Deterministic read (the eye): no model, read-only network (any non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS request is aborted). A failed read is an outcome in a 200 response, not an HTTP error.
observe.v1.title: POST /v1/observe

session.v1.description: Never returns cookies, profile paths or page content. `closed` = no browser running for it (a human may log in with the profile); `busy` = an operation is running.
session.v1.title: Browser sessions: GET /v1/sessions, GET /v1/sessions/{ref}, POST /v1/sessions/{ref}/release

verify.v1.description: A fresh observation of one record (a new page, never the one an act drove). Whether the goal holds is judged by the client.
verify.v1.title: POST /v1/verify

bearer.description: Required when the runtime was started with --token

info.summary: Browser sidecar: deterministic eye (Playwright) and model-driven hand (Computer Use)
info.title: WakeCore UI Runtime

post.summary: Run the Computer Use loop, at most once per key

get.summary: Full journal record of an act
What this runtime supports (negotiate before use)

post.summary: Check an extractor without opening a page

get.summary: Liveness, protocol version and session count

post.summary: Deterministic read of a page (the eye)
Close a session's browser so a human can log in with the same profile
